about: Allowed DIFFERENT gRPC-log comparison steps of scripts/remote/matrix. Read by scripts/remote/matrix_verdict.py. An entry holds only when every unmatched RPC on either side belongs to an action whose mnemonic is in only_mnemonics, at most max_actions distinct actions are involved, and (same_count_per_method) both sides have as many RPCs of each method. Anything else DIFFERENT fails the matrix.

entries.condition: Cold remote-cache run on re2: every unmatched RPC (FindMissingBlobs, ByteStream/Write, UpdateActionResult) belongs to one of the 21 TestRunner actions, and both sides issue the same number of RPCs per method.
entries.reason: A test action's outputs (test.log, test.xml) carry run times, so the digests a cold run uploads and records for the 21 re2 tests differ between any two runs, Bazel against itself included. Measured on matrix-re2a: 82 unmatched RPCs per side, all TestRunner, 21 action ids.
entries.source: lead-reported in docs/STATUS.md (In flight, remote: 're2 cold run differs only in the 21 test actions'); to be documented in docs/remote.md by the remote lead
